package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_serialization_map_any_json_decode_in_hot_path: Layer: Serialization and deserialization. Flag JSON decoding into map[string]any in hot paths where typed structs avoid reflection churn.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario593Positive(rawEvents [][]byte) ([]string, error) {
	var names []string
	for i, r := range rawEvents {
		var m map[string]any
		if err := json.Unmarshal(r, &m); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unmarshal event %d: %w", i, err)
		}
		if name, ok := m["name"].(string); ok {
			names = append(names, name)
		}
	}
	return names, nil
}
